title: Dictadura y democracia
goal: Read about constitutions used to expand rights rather than concentrate power -- a post-dictatorship text widening social rights, and Colombia's constitution recognizing Indigenous and Afro-Colombian communities and the tutela -- in contrast to restrictions under authoritarian governments.

items: Explain what a post-dictatorship constitution did for civil liberties and social rights.
Explain what the Colombian constitution sought to achieve after decades of political violence.
Describe who came to use the tutela.
State how the 1991 Colombian Constitution recognized indigenous and Afro-Colombian communities.
Use no solo... sino también to present two reinforcing facts.
